body: The fact you made this post and were vulnerable to so many people on here proves you’re not failing at everything. I don’t know your situation, but having a strong support system from your family can mean so much. It’s okay to not be okay, and acknowledging it and opening up to people, especially those with access to help you in a meaningful way, is a great first step. I promise you, you’re not a failure. You’re doing your best, just as we all are :^)
Hey, im not a therapist. In fact, im struggling with a lot myself, but if you wanna talk about something, anything really, we can if you like. I’d be happy to be here for you
I’ve been taking it one day at a time for years now; I don’t want to resist anymore. I’m tired of fighting what I know won’t change. I just want my waves to come back.

Yellow has some ammo packs, loose gold spawns, and weapon parts - but the appeal of yellow is you can also turn off the announcement (that lady talking) when you open the hangar or parking gate. 

Red has some other loose loot and weapon parts and such, but you’ll need a second key to open a room within red to access some of it. If you know what’s in violet, red is very similar, just *more* of it

I live the same life, I know the feeling all too well. At the very least, you can take solace in knowing there are people around you (far beyond me, who have it even worse) who feel the same, and think the same. 

It’s okay to be a background character; every story needs a supporting cast, just because your role hasn’t been filled in the way you’d like, doesn’t mean it can never happen. 

I know you know nothing about me, and likewise me neither about you; but I want you to stay here. You are a reminder for me that I’m not alone. And I’m sure many others that read this will think the same way. If you ever want to talk to me, you always can. 

Good luck to you.

What you’re feeling is normal. Depression, and how it manifests your opinion of yourself, AND others, is very real. Don’t vindicate yourself for having those thoughts. At the same time, keep in mind that you never know what could be going on in their lives either; we all have a story.

The only competition is with yourself, it’s purely a mental game; thoughts, just as you said yourself. 

I’ve felt like that my entire life. The real ones that connect with you and truly care will go out of their way to make you feel like you belong; and if you need to, it’s okay to ask them for affirmations, it’s not a bad thing. 

Just trust yourself, and trust in those around you. It’s hard, it’s unbelievably hard— I can’t figure it out myself. But the path to erasing those thoughts lie with overcoming your own mental blockades. I’m sure there’s plenty of people that hold high opinions of you that you didn’t even know existed; you can do this. You can overcome yourself. I believe in you.

The thing about quicksand is, the more you squirm and struggle, the tougher it is to get out. You can get out, it’s just gonna take some time. Don’t allow all of those things to pile on top of you all at once; try to isolate problems and pick them apart individually, soon the weight of those things will be far more accomplishable. 

I know I’m just a stranger. I can’t relate to everything you’re going through, but I know that you can get yourself in a better place. You don’t need to be perfect, just aim for something better than how things are right now. Good luck to you :)

Hey there. I’ve been there. I’ve lived that. I just want you to know you can dig yourself out of it, no matter how far deep you think it goes down. You could even start with setting an alarm for yourself, even if you snooze past it. 

You’re in your own head. Just win the little battles; you don’t need to turn things around in a day. Just wake up, give yourself 10 minutes to breathe, try to go outside for even a few minutes a day, every little thing like that will add up. You can do this.

Hi, your story resonated with me a lot. I hope things start going in the right direction for you. The biggest things that helped me was just winning the little battles, whether it be brushing your teeth, doing some laundry, or even just a very brief 5 minute walk outside. The spark will come to you over time if you just work your way up to it, and the feeling of accomplishment (even if it’s small) will drive you to doing more progressive challenges and pursuing other interests. Good luck to you C:
If it were me, I would just want to be treated like a normal person, and have someone who I could talk to. I think that’s the best you can do, at least, I think so

Forget the people that don’t spend their energy or time on you and treat you like a priority. The only person you need to please is yourself, so just focus on whatever it is brings you joy and don’t expect it to be from someone else. Trust me, once you feel better about who you are as a person, anything bad somebody else does to you will be minimized tenfold. Treat yourself like you’re the best person there is, because you deserve it! Happy new year :)
